name: Quiet time lets a fed-up mood go, a step at a time
case: A test fails and then the agent's turn fails, so Boop gets fed up: irritated or grumpy. Then nothing happens for hours, with the session still open. Boop's idle check-ins, every 15 to 30 minutes for the first two hours, let it calm down when its mood's minutes are up, a step at a time: by half an hour it's no longer grumpy, by an hour it's calm or nearly, and hours later it's calm, with a calm face at most. Past two hours only the hourly heartbeat comes.
why: characters/boop/steering/guide.md: after the minutes MOOD gives a mood fades a step toward calm, along the mood graph; the idle check-in (TranscriptView.idleWindowMs, the personality's idle_heartbeat) is the pass that brings it, and a check-in itself is no reason to say anything. characters/boop/steering/mood/annoyed.md: a turn failing after a failed check leaves annoyed for grumpy or irritated
